create_BenchmarkConfig: create a BenchmarkConfig dataclass with a name, list of tasks, and optional overrides
build_BenchmarkConfig_with_overrides: build a BenchmarkConfig with global overrides applied to all tasks in the benchmark
build_BenchmarkConfig_with_task_override: build a BenchmarkConfig with per-task overrides to customize individual task configurations
run_BenchmarkConfig_to_cfg_list: run to_cfg_list on a BenchmarkConfig to convert it into a list of MLEBenchTaskConfig objects
review_BenchmarkConfig_validate: review the BenchmarkConfig validate method to ensure the configuration is valid before use
